Document.Title: JL TANCERMAN - Klochendler family tree
Document.Description:
This is the KLOCHENDLER portion of my family tree. It was initially compiled on paper in 1961 with my father Jacques and grandmother Léa Tancerman, and grand-uncle David Klochendler, and I've erratically maintained it through the past 45 years or so, with the help of cousins over 2 continents. It is however quite incomplete, as the family has branched out exponentially through 4 or even 5 generations since then, and I would deeply appreciate all relevant input regarding family members past and present: names, dates of birth, etc. Hope you enjoy this genealogy in its present state.
Note: click the Menu symbol at top left (3 horizontal bars) and choose the genealogy "view" you want : the graphical TREE view is best suited with a computer or tablet, other views are ok with a phone. You can zoom, pan, drag the graphical tree for exploring, and click all items (names, links) for more details. Enjoy !
Your comments are welcome, as always. Jean-Louis Tancerman jltancerman@outlook.fr

Hermann KLOCHENDLER épouse sa cousine germaine Léa TANCERMAN, fille de sa tante Tema (et tante de Ethel KLOCHENDLER, 1ère épouse de son frère David)
David KLOCHENDLER épouse Ethel TANCERMAN, sa petite-cousine (petite-fille de sa tante Tema), par ailleurs nièce de sa belle-soeur Léa TANCERMAN (épouse de son frère aîné Hermann)
